text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm reviewing my training plans for
Bamboo
Memory in my office one day,
when...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: HELLO, TRAINER!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know this is sudden, but I really wanted
to ask
you something!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What can I do to prove that I'm the best
of the
best?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This year, my goal is to become the
greatest racer
in my distances. The thing
is...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I feel like taking on G1s and impressing
people
with my wins isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What I really want is some kind of...
proof. Like,
something physical that
anyone can look at and
understand right
away that I'm the one who
stands at the
top!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But I don't know what fits the bill! I can't
stop
thinking about it—it's driving me
crazy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Got any ideas? I want something that
just
screams, "This Umamusume is the
best of the
best!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not an easy question to answer, but I
believe
there is one thing that fits her
criteria.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! What is it?!
choice_data_list: 証明のひとつになりうるものはあるよ
choice_data_list_en: There is something that could serve as proof.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The URA gives out several awards each
year to
Umamusume who excel in certain
categories, one
of which is the award for
Best Sprinter.
choice_data_list: 『最優秀短距離ウマ娘』になることだ
『最優秀短距離ウマ娘』になることだよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It should be exactly the kind of proof
that
Bamboo Memory's looking for!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! The Best Sprinter award!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even consider that! It's got a nice
ring to it
as well—Best Sprinter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! It's settled, Trainer! My next
goal is to
win that award!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are two G1 sprints she can run in:
the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen and the
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's able to win both, she'll be one
definitive
step closer to earning that
title. That said, if she
wants to increase
her chances even more...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then she'll have to pick up victories in
other
graded sprints to help pad out her
resume!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So, I'll need to win some graded
sprints in
addition to those two G1s if I
really wanna make
a grab for the award,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That sounds like quite the challenge...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But I'm getting fired up just thinking
about it!
There's nothing like overcoming
difficulties to
earn glory, after all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! Let's get me that
award!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like I'll have to review our
training plan to
make sure we're on track
for Bamboo Memory to
win Best
Sprinter!
